title: Register Mini built-ins
description: make_global_env adds conversions, I/O, collection, higher-order, and math functions to the global environment.

steps.description: make_global_env starts an environment and registers conversion functions plus input and println.
len accepts strings and lists. range accepts one or two arguments and reports an error for other counts.
The higher-order helpers use an interpreter apply method to implement map, filter, and reduce, then register those built-ins.
These built-ins build and inspect lists, including append, head, tail, cons, and empty.
The final bindings expose selected math functions and return the completed global environment.
